QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Collect Ghost Paint!
QuestInfo.1:
#e[Gamsper's Mission]#n

-Collect 9,999 drops of Ghost Paint.

You'll get Ghost Paint just for being logged in, but if you want to collect them faster, you can hunt monsters around your level, collect #ePaint Tubes#n, play #eRock-Paper-Scissors#n against other players, or find a #eMysterious Ghost Paint Tube#n.
